name: Csikéria (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csikéria (a crowned shield of yellow, green and white with a bunch of grapes, a cross and ears of grain) above the name CSIKÉRIA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
